method: Display-only classification. Xbox IDs and names are retained. Matches require the complete corresponding edition achievement set and all name/Gamerscore matches to be unique. Case and punctuation differences may be normalized; translations or semantic name changes are not inferred. All base/pack counts and Gamerscore reconcile. Platforms are checked against public source metadata; conflicting Title IDs sharing a page are deferred. Description differences are logged separately because Xbox often exports unlocked wording. No list positions, achievement-ID ranges, event data, account IDs or account unlock progress are used.
